[[Vault 31]]/[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |TV actor = |dod =c. 2294 |dod verified=yes }} '''Ian Jackson''' was the [[overseer]] of [[Vault 32]] who perished during the rebellion in his Vault circa [[Timeline#2294|2294]]. ==Background== Like other overseers of both Vaults 32 and [[Vault 33|33]], he was a junior executive of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] and a participant of [[Bud Askins]]' executive assistant training program "[[Bud's Buds]],"Norm MacLean: "''Is this where my dad's from?''"
[[Bud Askins]]: "''You'll never find out. Oh. He's gonna find out. These are Bud's Buds. My Buds. America outsourced the survival of this country to the private sector. But it would have been insane to keep a failed nation alive. So, we kept Vault-Tec alive instead. A well-trained staff of highly supervised junior executives from my own assistant training program. Because the future of humanity comes down to one word: Management.''"
("[[The Beginning]]") kept in [[Cryonics|cryostasis]] in [[Vault 31]]. In the 23rd century, he was reactivated before [[Betty Pearson]] and assigned as the new overseer of Vault 32. During his tenure, [[Vault 32 dweller|the dwellers]] somehow learned that they were actually a part of a social experiment, treated as a breeding pool by the "Management" in Vault 31. The truth tore the Vault apart, with Jackson captured and tortured by the rebels before he was strangled with a cable in his office.[[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'']], "[[The Ghouls]]" The resulting civil war destroyed the Vault, with the dwellers killing each other, committing suicide, or otherwise wasting away. [[Lee Moldaver]] later assumed the guise of a Vault 32 overseer, using the intra-Vault messaging system to notify [[Hank MacLean]] of Jackson's passing (using the excuse of a crop blight) and introducing herself as the new overseer.[[Hank MacLean]]: "''Welcome, neighbors from Vault 32. I am Hank MacLean, overseer of Vault 33.''"
[[Lee Moldaver]]: "''Lee Moldaver, overseer of 32. Thank you for your hospitality.''"
Hank MacLean: "''Oh, we were sorry to hear of Overseer Jackson's passing in your telegrams.''"
Lee Moldaver: "''When blight hit our wheat, we lost a lot of good people, but this trade will help us get back on our feet.''"
Hank MacLean: "''Yes, well, as arranged, we offer you seed and parts for machinery.''"
Lee Moldaver: "''In exchange, we offer you a breeder.''" The charade worked, and Jackson's body and fate weren't found out until later, by [[Norm MacLean|Norm]] and [[Chet (TV series)|Chet]], exploring the wrecked Vault. Jackson's body was found with a grin, his right hand forced into a thumbs-up by the Vault Dwellers who killed him, a macabre imitation of the Vault Boy's iconic smile and gesture. His remains were eventually removed when Vault 32 was cleaned up for resettlement. ==Appearances== Ian Jackson's skeletal remains appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|4=104}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} {{Navbox overseers}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 32 characters]] [[Category:Overseers]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]]
